event.description: Factor the tied token matrix through a learned rank-6 code
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 6 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0016, which removed the fixed-length EOS row and unused final position at 3,376 parameters and 99.18%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0017, whose BOS removal scored 0.02%. Hypothesis: the 12 token vectors and tied output classifiers occupy a six-dimensional learned subspace even though the transformer residual stream remains 16-dimensional. This is a major token representational change: replace the current 185 grouped token scalars with a 12x6 code matrix and 6x16 shared projection initialized by the best rank-6 SVD, retaining exact input/output weight tying and yielding 1,655 parameters. It is more informative than rank 7 because rank-7 factors require 196 parameters and would not be strictly smaller than the current grouped matrix; rank 6 is the highest eligible subspace. Token streams, positional representation, attention, autoregressive logits, and generic greedy decoding remain otherwise unchanged.
